title: D6 agent output (d6-status-note-writer)
description: Section 12/D6 'Agent output' line and .claude/agents/d6-status-note-writer.md's worked output shape: {"syllabus_status", "note_type", "reason_note", "quoted_lines": [{"edition","passage_id","text"}]}. IMPORTANT split of responsibility (spec 12/D6 Worker line): the SCRIPT decides `syllabus_status` by the rule ladder 0/1/2/3/3b/4 and hands it to the agent in the work input; the agent only WRITES THE NOTE. So `syllabus_status` here must echo the script's decision unchanged — scripts/checks/D6.py fails the output if it does not. `note_type` is constrained by the status (the script passes the legal set as `allowed_note_types`), the template-shape check and the 'every quoted line exists in the edition it names' check also live in scripts/checks/D6.py, since both need the per-item input context. `note` is optional and carries Universal rule 7's 'if the input looks wrong, say so in note' — added deliberately because its absence from schemas/D1.json/D2.json was a real bug that silently rejected the very first real D1 run (docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md, 2026-10-12).

syllabus_status.description: Must equal the status the SCRIPT already decided and passed in the input (config/allowed_values.yaml syllabus_status).

note_type.description: One of the seven reason-note templates (spec 3.1, config/allowed_values.yaml note_type). The agent file's own Allowed values list omits `answer_changed` because only D7 can produce it (spec 12/D7: 'note type becomes answer_changed'); it is allowed here so the same schema validates a D7-rewritten note.

reason_note.description: The student-facing note, in its note_type's exact template from spec 3.1, quoting lines exactly. Template shape is checked in scripts/checks/D6.py.

edition.description: Which edition this line is copied from: L = latest (reprint 2026-27), O = the last edition before rationalisation, M = lab manual (spec 3 Core concepts / 6.1 book-id letters).

quoted_lines.description: Every line quoted anywhere in reason_note, each tagged with the edition it came from. May legitimately be empty only for note_type `outside` (whose template quotes nothing).

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
